module: VMware's BC-FJA (Bouncy Castle FIPS Java API)
caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 3 and operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy.
description: VMware’s BC-FJA (Bouncy Castle FIPS Java API) is a software cryptographic module that provides cryptographic functions and services to various VMware applications via a well-defined Java-language application programming interface (API).
